fire: During registration, the bakery owner submitted a DBA certificate listing the shop's trading name.
The florist filed a DBA before advertising her business under its new name.
Before launching the catering service, Elena checked whether a DBA registration was required.
At the licensing counter, the vendor presented his DBA paperwork and paid the filing fee.
Our accountant reviewed the DBA application after we selected a trading name for the partnership.
To record its public business name, the studio sent a DBA form to the county office.
Following the rebranding, the shop renewed its DBA and saved the registration receipt.
For the new repair business, Marcus obtained a DBA certificate showing the name customers would recognize.

The market seller brought his assumed-name paperwork to the licensing office and paid the filing fee.

When the store changed its branding, its owner renewed the trade-name registration and retained the receipt.
To establish the repair shop's public identity, Daniel obtained a certificate documenting its assumed business name.
